name: java-kernel
description: Installs the IJava Jupyter kernel from GitHub releases (https://github.com/ebpro/IJava/releases) or from a local artifacts directory and registers the kernelspec.

kernel_source.description: Where to get the kernel artifacts: 'release' (download from releases) or 'local' (use files from ARTIFACTS_DIR)

kernel_version.description: Kernel release version to download when using 'release' source (e.g. '1.2.3'). If empty the feature will try to use any matching artifact in ARTIFACTS_DIR.

jdk_version.description: JDK version to ensure (used by SDKMAN if present)

artifacts_base_url.description: Base URL used to construct release download when using 'release' source. Default points to the GitHub releases for ebpro/IJava.

artefact_url.description: Full URL to a specific kernel tarball; if provided it overrides the base URL + version behavior.

artifacts_dir.description: Path inside the build/container where local artifacts are available (e.g. /opt/solen/Artefacts or /tmp/Artefacts). The install script will look here for java-kernel-*.tar.gz.

required.description: If true, fail the build when the kernel cannot be installed. Set to false to tolerate missing kernel artifacts.
